item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #MisamisOriental(CagayanDeOroCity), #Bukidnon(Talakag, Baungon), #LanaoDelNorte(IliganCity, Tubod, Munai, Magsaysay, Tangcal), #LanaoDelSur(Maguing, PoonaBayabao, Masiu, Madalum, Madamba, Calanogas, Malabang, Balabagan, Pagayawan, Tubaran, LumbacaUnayan, Lumbatan, Butig, SultanDumalondong), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Parang, SultanMastura, SultanKudarat, DatuOdinSinsuat), #DavaoDelNorte(SanIsidro, Talaingod, NewCorella), #DavaoDeOro(Laak), #DavaoOccidental(JoseAbadSantos, Sarangani), #Sarangani(Malapatan, Maasim), #NorthCotabato(Pikit), #MaguindanaoDelSur(SultanSaBarongis, ShariffSaydonaMustapha, Pagalungan, Gen.S.K.Pendatun, DatuAbdullahSangki, RajahBuayan, Mamasapano, Paglat, Pandag, Buluan), #SultanKudarat(Lambayong, PresidentQuirino, CityOfTacurong), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Siayan, Labason, Gutalac), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dumingag, Sominot, Lakewood, PagadianCity, Labangan, Bayog, Dinas), #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan, Naga, Siay, Diplahan), #TawiTawi(Sitangkai, Sibutu, Simunul, SapaSapa, Bongao, PanglimaSugala, Tandubas, Languyan, SouthUbian), #Sulu(Pangutaran and Pandami) within the next 1-2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
